name: New entry

title: "[new entry] short name"

---

The map gives an entry of its own only to work that a venue has adopted or published (a working group, a community group, a foundation, a standards body, or the maintainers of a published specification). Other work can go in as a sentence in an existing entry or as an open proposal; say below if that would also be fine.

**Proposed entry id** (lowercase, hyphens):

**Name of the work:**

**Venue that adopted or published it, with the public URL of that decision or publication:**

**State** (version, status as the venue states it, date):

**Seam** (S1 Discovery, S2 Product and seller identity, S3 Agent identity and delegation, S4 Signed terms, authorisation and receipts) **and one sentence on why it belongs there:**

**Public sources** (one per line: URL, date you read it, and whether it is the normative text, a decision, a statement, or a third-party description):

**Quote from the main source** (40 words at most):

**Existing entries it overlaps with**, if any:

**Disclosure:** your role in the work you propose (author, maintainer, chair, contributor) and any employer or commercial interest in it, or "none".
